facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Health's family health directorate gives completeness of monthly activity reports in DHIS2 as 96% nationally and timeliness as 89% for October to December 2025 (lowest in the East, 83% and 70%; North 100% and 98%), read from DHIS2 on 23 February 2026; it gives no count or share of facilities entering their own reports.

systems.country_label: DHIS2 (District Health Information Software); rapports mensuels d'activités
systems.tiers: monthly activity reports from health facilities (formations sanitaires) in all 10 regions; levels not stated

note: The bulletin is a quarterly analysis of aggregate maternal, neonatal and child health indicators drawn from DHIS2; it does not say who runs the system, where reports are keyed or which facility levels enter them.
